name: Feather
description: The sole remaining angel who turned herself in and later becomes Boros guildleader.

description_citations.text: "The Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos studies the Schism and sees the Kuga mot while searching for Feather and Parhelion.
timeline.quote: The Kuga Mot appears, a mysterious glowing sphere or apparition

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos is impaled in the crash, sees Feather emerge from the kuga mot, and dies.
timeline.quote: and Agrus Kos passes away.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Boros angel Feather throws the comatose Rakdos back into his lava pit.
timeline.quote: the comatose Rakdos was thrown back into his lava pit, Rix Maadi, by the Boros angel Feather

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather is brought before the Azorius and Teysa recognizes her as the client who wants her as Advokist.
timeline.quote: When she reaches the cell, she recognizes her client as the angel known as Feather .

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather explains that Ravnica's seal folded over itself to create Agyrem, where the ghosts live.
timeline.quote: Like a blister on the skin, the seal folded over itself to create Agyrem , a mysterious place where the ghosts of Ravnica live.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 8". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: in Agyrem, the ghost of Szadek kills Razia and Feather flees.
timeline.quote: Then the ghost of Szadek appears and kills Razia.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 9". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Two years later Kos is brought back to Ravnica as a ghost with a semi-corporeal body.
timeline.quote: Two years later the new Azorius guildmaster, on behalf of Feather (who has become the new Boros guildmaster), manages to bring Kos back to Ravnica.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather dumps Rakdos' body back into his lava pit.
timeline.quote: Later, the new Boros guildmaster Feather dumped Rakdos' body back into his lava pit

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Parhelion reappears on a collision course with Prahv as the Azorius, Boros and Selesnya become embroiled in a scandal over Feather, who turned herself in.
timeline.quote: The Dissension began with the dramatic reappearance of the Parhelion

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather becomes Boros guildleader, Leonos II takes over the Azorius, Jarad returns as a lich, and the Simic remain leaderless.
timeline.quote: Feather became the new guildleader of the Boros, Leonos II took the reigns of the Azorius

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the mess hall Krenko overhears Boros soldiers saying the guild's succession has come down to a duel, found by the Azorius in the fine print.
timeline.quote: "No, the nosy Azorius found it in the fine print," he said.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: A goblin worker tells Krenko that Aurelia will replace the disgraced angel Vinrenn as master, who will be banished.
timeline.quote: Aurelia's gonna be our new master, 'cause she says that no disgraced angel's got the right to rule.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko sets fires and bombs through the floors of Sunhome to create chaos and slips unnoticed into Vinrenn's chambers.
timeline.quote: Chaos is the best cover, and Krenko went about setting fires and kicking down doors.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko finds an angel in stasis inside a detention sphere and smashes it open with the shiv's handle.
timeline.quote: With another good smash, the sphere dissipated, sending the angel tumbling unceremoniously to the floor.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko plucks two feathers from the angel and falsely screams that she attacked him, and guards seize her.
timeline.quote: "She tried to escape! She's free. She attacked me!"

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Aurelia replaces Feather as leader of the Boros, arguing a disgraced angel cannot command respect.
timeline.quote: Feather was later replaced by one of these Angels, Aurelia

citation.text: "Angel", section "Firemane angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Razia's death, the Boros work as hired guards, mostly for Orzhov families, under guildmaster Feather.
timeline.quote: the Boros mainly worked as paid bodyguards and security officials for the highest bidders, mostly Orzhov families

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The Interregnum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Discontented Boros gather under the war-leader Aurelia, who argues that no disgraced angel should lead them.
timeline.quote: gathered under the war-leader Aurelia, who argued that no disgraced angel should lead the Boros

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The Interregnum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aurelia replaces Feather as leader of the Boros.
timeline.quote: Aurelia ascended to the leadership of the Boros

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Replacing Feather". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather brings Kos's spirit back as a spirit officer for the Wojek in Agyrem.
timeline.quote: his spirit was brought back by Feather, who recruited him as a spirit officer for the Wojek

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos and Feather publicly arrest Mr. Gullmott on stage during a production of the Signing of the Guildpact, and Yertrude vanishes from the audience, returning as a seeker ghost that Kos destroys.
timeline.quote: Kos and Feather very publicly arrested Mr. Gullmott while he was enraged and enchanted on-stage in a production of the Signing of the Guildpact .

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather is placed in the League of Wojek to work off a holy debt, her wings bound.
timeline.quote: Feather was placed in the League of Wojek to work off a holy debt, and her wings were bound

citation.text: "Feather", section "Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Decamillennial, Kos frees her wings and she vanishes looking for the Parhelion.
timeline.quote: Kos freed her wings and she vanished, looking for the missing Parhelion

citation.text: "Feather", section "Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather returns on sensing Kos's death and is chosen as a pallbearer.
timeline.quote: She reappeared when she sensed Kos's death.

citation.text: "Feather", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather submits for arrest during the Dissension, revealing she is the last surviving Boros angel; later she is named Boros Guildmaster.
timeline.quote: she was named as the Boros Guildmaster

citation.text: "Feather", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aurelia challenges Feather's rule and Feather is imprisoned.
timeline.quote: Feather was imprisoned until her final fate could be decided.

citation.text: "Feather", section "Deposed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Krenko frees Feather in a secretive raid.
timeline.quote: Feather was freed, however, during a secretive raid performed by Krenko .

citation.text: "Feather", section "Deposed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark Feather flies alongside Aurelia's Firemanes.
timeline.quote: she was allowed to fly alongside Aurelia's Firemanes

citation.text: "Feather", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather is restricted from the Parhelion and forced to serve the Wojek with bound wings.
timeline.quote: her wings were bound and she was forced to serve the Wojek

citation.text: "Parhelion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Borca's ghost tells Kos he must avenge him; Kos and Feather find Fonn and Jarad at Pivlic's arena restaurant and ally against attacking Selesnya quietmen.
timeline.quote: they form an alliance when Selesnya quietmen attack the arena

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ludmilla leads the Golgari attack on Centerfort and is spared by Feather on condition of never showing her face on the surface.
timeline.quote: Ludmilla later led the Golgari attack on Centerfort during the Decamillennial.

citation.text: "Sisters of Stone Death", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
